# shader program descriptors and the texture's plane, and the buffer of the
# draw's descriptors (resource tables, sampler, texture descriptor).
#
# Board: NanoPC-T6 (RK3588, Mali-G610, GPU_ID 0xa8670005), Armbian,
# Linux 6.18.55-current-rockchip64, panthor 1.5.0, Mesa 25.0.7-2+deb13u1.
# The program, 0dce654a8:tools/mali/board-ref/2026-10-19-texture-formats/fmt.c: a
# 64x64 RGBA8 FBO, a full-screen quad sampling, GL_NEAREST: a 16x8
# GL_ETC1_RGB8_OES texture (etc1), an 8x8 GL_COMPRESSED_RGBA8_ETC2_EAC one
# (etc2rgba), a 4x4 GL_SRGB8_ALPHA8 one (srgb); each "pixels 4096: not as
# predicted 0", by tools/mali/mesa-board-ref.sh, cut by
# tools/mali/board_dump_cut.py <dump> <source> 7fffffffd000 7ffffffd4000:
#   etc1: mesa-etc1.pandecode sha256 9dc826dc68b9accc2428bb7762523b842f228e914a08a299a481ee752d138e95

#   srgb: mesa-srgb.pandecode sha256 43cf68b24553f65f42ab9c0a1221d5b4e2b053b33e64d0472c6f84284c58fb4e
# Each block is headed by its line range in the full file.
